title: chrysanthemum rockii
intro: Chrysanthemum rockii, commonly known as the Rockii chrysanthemum or Korean chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum rockii include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, as well as anti-oxidative and anti-aging properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
